title.value: High-Order Pooling for Graph Neural Networks with Tensor Decomposition
title.justification: The main research topic and the proposed methodology focus on the use of high-order pooling using tensor decomposition for graph neural networks.
title.quote: High-Order Pooling for Graph Neural Networks with Tensor Decomposition

extractions.description: This paper introduces the Tensorized Graph Neural Network (tGNN), which utilizes tensor decomposition to model high-order non-linear interactions among nodes in graph neural networks. The focus is on improving the pooling operations by leveraging symmetric CP decomposition to create a more expressive GNN architecture. Theoretical and empirical analyses show tGNN's superiority over standard GNN architectures in node and graph classification tasks.
